create.name: Hilary Jackendoff
create.bio:
Hilary Jackendoff is a yoga nidra and meditation teacher, teacher trainer and Human Design reader who works from Los Angeles under the name Meditation Chick. She read philosophy, mysticism and religion at university, then in 2008 began formal training in a Tantric yoga tradition, taking initiation in the Saraswati order and living as a monastic at an ashram for two years while completing a long residential teacher training. After eight years inside a guru-based lineage she stepped back from it, and she now calls her approach post-lineage: rooted in tradition but not bound to it.

Her teaching is relaxed, irreverent and practical, with self-inquiry at its centre. She offers Human Design readings and coaching sessions that use the chart as a starting point for looking at habits and beliefs, a fifty-hour meditation teacher training, a three-month group mentorship for women who teach, and one-to-one mentoring for teachers building their work. She also leads workshops, chanting series and occasional retreats in person and online, and shares guided practices on Insight Timer.

courses.title: Human Design Readings
courses.description: One-to-one readings of your Human Design chart, from a first look at type, strategy and authority to follow-ups and readings for relationships.

courses.title: Self-Inquiry Sessions
courses.description: Coaching sessions that use your Human Design chart as a shared map for looking at habits, beliefs and decisions, and for learning to trust your own inner guidance.

courses.title: Meditation Teacher Training (50-hour Foundations)
courses.description: A fifty-hour training in teaching beginners' meditation, covering how to hold space, guide practices, record meditations and work with private clients.

courses.title: Sacred Spiral Mentorship
courses.description: A three-month group mentorship for women who teach, combining self-inquiry through Human Design with clear intentions, shared accountability and community.

courses.title: Teacher Mentorship
courses.description: Monthly one-to-one mentoring for yoga and meditation teachers, in three- or six-month packages, mixing practical guidance with inner work.
